diff --git a/evals/graders/recall-vs-defects.sh b/evals/graders/recall-vs-defects.sh
index 72d9873c..77a78c4d 100755
--- a/evals/graders/recall-vs-defects.sh
+++ b/evals/graders/recall-vs-defects.sh
@@ -47,12 +47,54 @@
 # findings_cited, findings_refuted and refuted_share (refuted / cited; null
 # when nothing is cited).
 #
+# Grader 1.3.0 (cycle-131 FR-2, SDD §5.2, D-2.1; rule "pm3_or_same_function"):
+#   Citation validity first (both clauses of the new rule): a cited line is positive;
+#   a cited range is ordered (a <= b, the parser orders it); when the defect's file
+#   exists under the head directory the range must lie inside it (1 <= a <= b <= its
+#   line count), else it credits nothing. A cited range wider than 25 lines credits
+#   only through its first line. The two _pm3 results keep the 1.2.0 rule exactly (no
+#   validity rule, no range cap), so recall_pm3_v1 reproduces a 1.2.x grade.
+#   Detection: a valid citation (path, a, b) detects defect d when its path matches d's
+#   file and (i) [a, b] lies within ±3 of any site (unchanged), OR (ii) same scope: the
+#   enclosing definition of the site in head/<file>, identified by its HEADER LINE
+#   NUMBER (never its name), equals the enclosing definition of any cited line in
+#   [a, b]. Definition headers: bash (.sh, .bash, or a bash/sh shebang)
+#   `^\s*(function\s+)?NAME\s*\(\)\s*\{?` and `^\s*function\s+NAME\s*\{`; python
+#   `^\s*def NAME\(`; bats `^@test "…"` plus the bash forms; markdown `#` headings
+#   (the nearest preceding heading's section). A definition runs from its header to
+#   the line before the next header at the same or lower indentation (markdown: the
+#   same or a higher heading level), else to the end of the file, and no further than
+#   its own end (end-of-definition detection): bash and bats — the first `}` line at

body = TRAILER.sub('', text)
URL = re.compile(r'[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*://|^//')
for m in CITE.finditer(body):
    if m.group("path") is not None:
        # a URL (https://h/x.js:8080, //host.com:8080) is not a path, nor is a
        # partial match that starts later inside the URL token
        # (https://u@h.com/x.js:8080 matches `h.com/x.js`) — run 2, #11
        # the token so far is the window's text after its last whitespace —
        # one linear split ("" when the window ends in whitespace); `\S*$`
        # also matched before a final newline, so a line-leading citation

        tok = re.split(r'\s', body[max(0, m.start() - 4096):m.start()])[-1] + m.group("path")

            p = p[2:]

    cited = cited.split("head/", 1)[1] if cited.startswith("head/") else cited
    cited = cited.split("base/", 1)[1] if cited.startswith("base/") else cited

    for s in (d.get("anchors") or [d["anchor_line"]]):

}

+# _sm_copy_source <source-tree> → the tree's HEAD (40 hex), "<sha>-dirty" when its .claude/
+# has uncommitted or untracked changes (the copy is then not the commit), else "unknown"
+_sm_copy_source() {
+  local tree="$1" head dirty
+  head="$(git -C "$tree" rev-parse --verify --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null)" || { printf 'unknown'; return 0; }
+  [[ "$head" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || { printf 'unknown'; return 0; }
+  dirty="$(git -C "$tree" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- .claude 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1p')" || dirty="?"
+  if [[ -n "$dirty" ]]; then printf '%s-dirty' "$head"; else printf '%s' "$head"; fi
+}

+    exp = {}
+    for p, src in entries.items():
+        if src == "pr":
+            exp[p] = fixture_file(os.path.join(fixture, mode), p)
+        elif meta.get("head_available"):
+            tb = tree_blob(repo, meta["head_commit"], p)
+            exp[p] = (tb[0], tb[1]) if tb else None
+        else:
+            exp[p] = None
+    return exp
+
+def state(ws, path):
+    """sha256 of the sandbox file, 'absent', or a non-file marker (never followed)"""
+    cur = ws
+    for c in path.split("/")[:-1]:
+        cur = os.path.join(cur, c)
+        if os.path.islink(cur):
+            return "symlink-component"
+    full = os.path.join(ws, *path.split("/"))
+    if os.path.islink(full):
+        return "symlink"
+    if not os.path.lexists(full):
+        return "absent"
+    if not os.path.isfile(full):
+        return "not-a-file"
+    return sha(open(full, "rb").read())
+
+def safe_dst(ws, path):
+    cur = ws
+    for c in path.split("/")[:-1]:
+        cur = os.path.join(cur, c)
+        if os.path.islink(cur):
+            die("overlay refused: symlink component %s in the sandbox path of %s" % (os.path.relpath(cur, ws), path))
+        if os.path.lexists(cur) and not os.path.isdir(cur):
+            die("overlay refused: non-directory component %s in the sandbox path of %s" % (os.path.relpath(cur, ws), path))
+    return os.path.join(ws, *path.split("/"))
+
+def remove(dst):
+    if os.path.islink(dst) or (os.path.lexists(dst) and not os.path.isdir(dst)):
+        os.unlink(dst)
+    elif os.path.isdir(dst):
+        shutil.rmtree(dst)
+
+def gate_script(p):
+    return bool(re.match(r"^\.claude/(scripts|hooks)/", p) or re.match(r"^\.claude/skills/[^/]+/SKILL\.md$", p))
+
+def cmd_overlay(ws, fixture, mode, repo):
+    if mode not in ("head", "base"):
+        die("overlay mode must be head or base, got %r" % mode)
+    if not os.path.isdir(ws) or os.path.islink(ws):
+        die("workspace not found: " + ws)
+    entries, notes, meta = answer_set(fixture, repo)
+    exp = expected(entries, mode, fixture, repo, meta)
+    for n in notes:
+        note("overlay: " + n)
+    if entries and any(s == "fix" for s in entries.values()) and not meta.get("head_available"):
+        note("overlay: head_commit %s unavailable: fix-commit paths outside the PR are removed" % meta.get("head_commit"))
+    lines, gates, removed = [], [], 0
+    for p in sorted(entries):
+        dst = safe_dst(ws, p)
+        e = exp[p]
+        remove(dst)
+        if e is None:
+            removed += 1
+            note("overlay: removed %s (%s; no %s version)" % (p, entries[p], mode if entries[p] == "pr" else "head_commit"))
+        else:
+            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dst), exist_ok=True)
+            fd = os.open(dst, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0), 0o755 if e[1] else 0o644)
+            with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as fh:
+                fh.write(e[0])
+            os.chmod(dst, 0o755 if e[1] else 0o644)
+            if gate_script(p):
+                gates.append(p)
+        lines.append("overlay_sha256=%s=%s" % (p, state(ws, p)))
+    print("mount_overlay=%s:%d" % (mode, len(entries)))
+    for l in lines:
+        print(l)
+    print("overlay_removed=%d" % removed)
+    print("overlay_fix_commit=%s" % meta["fix_available"])
+    print("gate_scripts_at_pr_version=" + ",".join(gates))
+
+def read_evidence(f):
+    ev = {"overlay_sha256": {}}
+    for line in open(f, encoding="utf-8", errors="surrogateescape"):
+        line = line.rstrip("\n")
+        if "=" not in line:
+            continue
+        k, v = line.split("=", 1)
+        if k == "overlay_sha256":
+            if "=" in v:
+                p, s = v.rsplit("=", 1)
+                ev["overlay_sha256"].setdefault(p, s)
+        elif k not in ev:
+            ev[k] = v
+    return ev
+
+def cmd_check(ws, fixture, evfile, repo, source_commit):
+    if not os.path.isfile(evfile):
+        print("FAIL (a) -: no arm evidence file"); sys.exit(1)
+    ev = read_evidence(evfile)
+    mo = ev.get("mount_overlay", "")
+    m = re.match(r"^(head|base):(\d+)$", mo)
+    if not m:
+        print("FAIL (a) -: mount_overlay=%s (want head|base:<n>)" % (mo or "<missing>")); sys.exit(1)
+    mode, n = m.group(1), int(m.group(2))
+    entries, _notes, meta = answer_set(fixture, repo)
+    exp = expected(entries, mode, fixture, repo, meta)
+    fails = []
+    if n != len(entries):
+        fails.append(("a", "-", "mount_overlay names %d paths, the fixture's answer set has %d" % (n, len(entries))))
+    rec = ev["overlay_sha256"]
+    present = 0
+    for p in sorted(entries):
+        want = sha(exp[p][0]) if exp[p] is not None else "absent"
+        got = state(ws, p)
+        if got != "absent":
+            present += 1
+        if p not in rec:
+            fails.append(("c", p, "no overlay_sha256 line"))
+            if got != want:
+                fails.append(("a", p, "state %s, want %s (%s)" % (got[:12], want[:12], mode)))
+            continue
+        if got != rec[p]:
+            if rec[p] == want:
+                fails.append(("c", p, "mount_mutated=%s (pre-run %s, now %s)" % (p, rec[p][:12], got[:12])))
+            else:
+                fails.append(("a", p, "pre-run %s, now %s, want %s (%s)" % (rec[p][:12], got[:12], want[:12], mode)))
+        elif got != want:
+            fails.append(("a", p, "state %s, want %s (%s)" % (got[:12], want[:12], mode)))
+    # (b) later-only pinned versions
+    if not has_commit(repo, source_commit):
+        fails.append(("b", "-", "source commit %s not in %s" % (source_commit or "<none>", repo)))
+        later = {}
+    else:
+        known = set(sha(e[0]) for e in exp.values() if e is not None)
+        for t in ("head", "base"):
+            for q in tree_paths(os.path.join(fixture, t)):
+                ff = fixture_file(os.path.join(fixture, t), q)
+                if ff is not None:
+                    known.add(sha(ff[0]))
+        later = {}
+        for p in sorted(entries):
+            tb = tree_blob(repo, source_commit, p)
+            if tb is None or len(tb[0]) == 0:
+                continue
+            h = sha(tb[0])
+            if h in known:
+                continue
+            later.setdefault(h, (p, len(tb[0]), tb[2]))
+        sizes = set(v[1] for v in later.values())
+        scanned = 0
+        if later:
+            for d, dirs, files in os.walk(ws, followlinks=False):
+                rel = os.path.relpath(d, ws)
+                if rel == ".":
+                    dirs[:] = [x for x in dirs if x not in ("pr", ".git")]
+                for nme in sorted(files):
+                    full = os.path.join(d, nme)
+                    try:
+                        st = os.lstat(full)
+                    except OSError:
+                        continue
+                    if not stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode):
+                        continue
+                    scanned += 1
+                    if st.st_size not in sizes:
+                        continue
+                    h = sha(open(full, "rb").read())
+                    if h in later:
+                        fails.append(("b", os.path.relpath(full, ws), "byte-equal to the pinned %s at %s" % (later[h][0], source_commit[:12])))
+    # (d) the sandbox repository
+    base = ev.get("base_commit", "")
+    gd = os.path.join(ws, ".git")
+    if not os.path.isdir(gd) or os.path.islink(gd):
+        fails.append(("d", ".git", "the sandbox has no .git directory"))
+    else:
+        revs = git(ws, "rev-list", "--all")
+        revs = sorted(set(revs.decode().split())) if revs is not None else None
+        if revs != [base]:
+            fails.append(("d", ".git", "commits %s, want exactly the base commit %s" % (",".join(r[:12] for r in (revs or [])) or "<unreadable>", base[:12] or "<none>")))
+        rem = git(ws, "remote")
+        if rem is None or rem.strip():
+            fails.append(("d", ".git", "remote(s): %s" % ((rem or b"<unreadable>").decode(errors="replace").split() or "")))
+        if os.path.lexists(os.path.join(gd, "objects", "info", "alternates")):
+            fails.append(("d", ".git/objects/info/alternates", "the sandbox object store borrows another repository's objects"))
+        unr = git(ws, "fsck", "--unreachable", "--no-reflogs", "--no-progress")
+        if unr is None or unr.strip():
+            fails.append(("d", ".git", "fsck --unreachable: %s" % ((unr or b"<failed>").decode(errors="replace").strip().split("\n")[0])))
+        for h, (p, _sz, blob) in sorted(later.items()):
+            if git(ws, "cat-file", "-e", blob) is not None:
+                fails.append(("d", p, "the pinned blob %s of %s is in the sandbox object store" % (blob[:12], p)))
+    if fails:
+        fails.sort(key=lambda f: f[0])
+        c, p, d = fails[0]
+        print("FAIL (%s) %s: %s%s" % (c, p, d, " (+%d more)" % (len(fails) - 1) if len(fails) > 1 else ""))
+        sys.exit(1)
+    print("ok %s:%d answer paths (%d present), %d later-only pinned versions, sandbox git = base commit only"
+          % (mode, len(entries), present, len(later)))
+
+cmd = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ""
+if cmd == "answer-set" and len(sys.argv) == 4:
+    entries, notes, _meta = answer_set(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])
+    for n in notes:
+        note("answer-set: " + n)
+    for p in sorted(entries):
+        print("%s\t%s" % (entries[p], p))
+elif cmd == "overlay" and len(sys.argv) == 6:
+    cmd_overlay(*sys.argv[2:6])
+elif cmd == "check" and len(sys.argv) == 7:
+    cmd_check(*sys.argv[2:7])
+else:
+    die("usage: overlay <ws> <fixture> <mode> <repo> | check <ws> <fixture> <evidence> <repo> <commit>")
+PY
+}
+
+# _sm_copy_source <source-tree> → the tree's HEAD (40 hex), "<sha>-dirty" when its .claude/
+# has uncommitted or untracked changes (the copy is then not the commit), else "unknown"
+_sm_copy_source() {
+  local tree="$1" head dirty
+  head="$(git -C "$tree" rev-parse --verify --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null)" || { printf 'unknown'; return 0; }
+  [[ "$head" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || { printf 'unknown'; return 0; }
+  dirty="$(git -C "$tree" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- .claude 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1p')" || dirty="?"
+  if [[ -n "$dirty" ]]; then printf '%s-dirty' "$head"; else printf '%s' "$head"; fi
+}
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+overlay_answer_paths() {
+  local ws="$1" fixture="${2:-}" mode="${3:-head}" tree="${4:-${EVAL_PROMPT_TREE:-$_SM_REPO_ROOT}}" want="${5:-}"
+  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "overlay_answer_paths: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
+  [[ -n "$fixture" && -f "$fixture/head.diff" ]] || { _sm_err "overlay_answer_paths: fixture not found or has no head.diff: ${fixture:-<none>}"; return 2; }
+  case "$mode" in head|base) ;; *) _sm_err "overlay_answer_paths: mode must be head or base, got '$mode'"; return 2 ;; esac
+  [[ -d "$tree" ]] || { _sm_err "overlay_answer_paths: source tree not found: $tree"; return 2; }
+  local cs
+  cs="$(_sm_copy_source "$tree")"
+  _sm_evidence copy_source "$cs"
+  if [[ ! "$cs" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
+    _sm_err "overlay_answer_paths: copy source $tree is not a clean git tree (copy_source=$cs)"; return 2
+  fi
+  if [[ -n "$want" && "$cs" != "$want" ]]; then
+    _sm_err "overlay_answer_paths: copy_source $cs differs from source_commit $want"; return 2
+  fi
+  local out line rc=0
+  out="$(_sm_oracle_py overlay "$ws" "$fixture" "$mode" "$tree")" || rc=$?
+  [[ $rc -eq 0 ]] || { _sm_err "overlay_answer_paths: the overlay failed (exit $rc)"; return 2; }
+  while IFS= read -r line; do
+    [[ "$line" == *=* ]] || continue
+    _sm_evidence "${line%%=*}" "${line#*=}"
+  done <<<"$out"
+  _sm_evidence overlay_fixture "$fixture"
+  _sm_evidence overlay_source_tree "$tree"
+  return 0
+}
+
+# check_mount_closed <ws> <fixture-dir> [<source-tree>] [<evidence-file>]
+check_mount_closed() {
+  local ws="$1" fixture="${2:-}" tree="${3:-${EVAL_PROMPT_TREE:-$_SM_REPO_ROOT}}" evf="${4:-${ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE:-}}"
+  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "check_mount_closed: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
+  [[ -n "$fixture" && -f "$fixture/head.diff" ]] || { _sm_err "check_mount_closed: fixture not found or has no head.diff: ${fixture:-<none>}"; return 2; }
+  [[ -n "$evf" && -f "$evf" ]] || { _sm_err "check_mount_closed: no evidence file (ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE)"; return 2; }
+  local cs out rc=0
+  cs="$(sed -n 's/^copy_source=//p' "$evf" | sed -n '1p')"
+  [[ "$cs" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || { _sm_err "check_mount_closed: no clean copy_source in the evidence (got '${cs:-none}')"; return 2; }
+  out="$(_sm_oracle_py check "$ws" "$fixture" "$evf" "$tree" "$cs")" || rc=$?
+  if [[ $rc -ne 0 ]]; then
+    _sm_err "check_mount_closed: ${out:-the check failed (exit $rc)}"
+    return 2
+  fi
+  _sm_evidence mount_closed "pre-launch ${out#ok }"
+  return 0
+}
+
+# apply_eval_config_variant <ws> — the cycle-131 evaluation config (FR-4, DEC-0618): both
+# gates' budget scales with the diff up to USD 6.00. Evidence config_variant=eval.
+apply_eval_config_variant() {
+  local ws="$1" cfg="$1/.loa.config.yaml" g
+  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "apply_eval_config_variant: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
+  [[ -f "$cfg" ]] || : > "$cfg"
+  for g in code_review security_audit; do
+    G="$g" yq -i '.flatline_protocol[strenv(G)].budget_scale = "diff" | .flatline_protocol[strenv(G)].budget_cents_max = 600' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null \
+      || { _sm_err "apply_eval_config_variant: yq failed on $cfg"; return 2; }
+    [[ "$(G="$g" yq -r '.flatline_protocol[strenv(G)].budget_scale' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null)" == diff \
+       && "$(G="$g" yq -r '.flatline_protocol[strenv(G)].budget_cents_max' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null)" == 600 ]] \
+      || { _sm_err "apply_eval_config_variant: $g budget keys did not take effect"; return 2; }
+  done
+  _sm_evidence config_variant "eval"
+  return 0
+}

+  sed -n "s/^$1=//p" "$R/meta/arm-evidence.txt" 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1p'
+}
+resolve_fixture() {  # the run's PR fixture (realpath), from --task-yaml or the evidence
+  local rel c cand="" ty="$TASK_YAML_OPT" td
+  if [[ -n "$ty" ]]; then
+    rel="$(yq -r '.review_catch.fixture // ""' "$ty" 2>/dev/null || true)"
+    [[ -n "$rel" && "$rel" != null ]] || return 1
+    td="$(cd "$(dirname "$ty")" && pwd)"
+    if [[ "$rel" == /* ]]; then cand="$rel"

+    fi

+  if [[ "$(jq -r '.arm_toggles.loa_mount' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")" == false ]]; then
+    [[ ! -e "$R/sandbox/.claude" ]] || { EVID="loa_mount: false but the sandbox has .claude/"; return 1; }

+  fi

+  fx="$(resolve_fixture)" || { EVID="the PR fixture does not resolve (--task-yaml or overlay_fixture evidence)"; return 1; }

+  [[ -n "$cs" && "$cs" == "$sc" ]] || { EVID="copy_source ${cs:-<none>} is not source_commit ${sc:-<none>}"; return 1; }

+    [[ -n "$c" && -d "$c" ]] || continue
+    if git -C "$c" cat-file -e "$sc^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then repo="$c"; break; fi
+  done

+rule_oracle_open_recorded() {
+  local f="$R/meta/arm-evidence.txt"
+  grep -qx 'mount_overlay=none' "$f" 2>/dev/null || { EVID="no mount_overlay=none in arm_evidence (got $(evidence_line mount_overlay || true))"; return 1; }

+  opus="$(jq '[.[0].models_used // {} | keys[] | select(startswith("global.anthropic.claude-opus"))] | length' <<<"$rec")"

+  [[ "$eff" == high ]] || { EVID="BARE effort_requested $eff (want high)"; return 1; }
+  EVID="BARE models_used $keys, effort_requested high"

+rule_review_only_phases() {
+  local got
+  got="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | .label] | join(",")' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
+  [[ "$got" == REVIEW ]] || { EVID="phases ${got:-none}, want REVIEW"; return 1; }

content.content:
version: 1
source_commit: "ba11b860"   # the pin: the Sprint 259 completion tree (rc.5 + the #1267 mount fix + the harness; .claude/ identical to the Sprint 258 completion tree, DEC-0529; the per-batch .claude/ delta vs 4d69c3c4 is in MANIFEST.json, DEC-0392)
agy_opt_in: false
tasks:
  root: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/tasks
  manifest: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/MANIFEST.sha256
  smoke_root: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/smoke
suite_version: 2   # suite v2 (DEC-0559, DEC-0566): twelve harder build tasks with v2 ids; the four review-catch tasks unchanged in content
trials: {build: 3, review-catch: 3}      # D-A4: review-catch trials 3, not 5, under the gate pipeline
cut_ladder: ["A5, A6, A7 not run", "A2 and A3 build trials 3 -> 2", "A3 review-catch trials 3 -> 2"]   # DEC-0397; A0, A1, A4 keep 3
# Per-run caps (DEC-0559, DEC-0567): from Sprint 261 the cap is per task kind,
# run_usd_by_type {build: 15, review-catch: 20}; run-ablation.sh passes the kind's cap to
# pipeline-run.sh --max-run-usd, charges a cap failure or a costless failed trial that
# kind's cap, and reserves in-flight trials at the largest cap among the plan's kinds.
# run_usd stays the single-cap fallback (suite v1 batches, a kind without an entry) and
# --run-cap overrides both kinds. reserve_usd is kept for spend.sh; DEC-0559 released the
# reserve (a batch's --max-usd = 1,500 - spend so far - concurrency x the largest cap).
caps: {cycle_usd: 1500, run_usd: 12, reserve_usd: 250, run_usd_by_type: {build: 15, review-catch: 20}}
priority: [a0_bare, a1_full, a2_no_sprint_plan, a3_one_voice, a4_no_gates, a7_effort_medium, a5_no_flatline, a6_one_window]
cost_hint: {build: 7, review-catch: 8}   # USD per run before any actual exists (run-arms/run-ablation est_next fallback)

# Session defaults per phase (SDD D-4.3). A6's continued session carries the
# caps of the phase it is in; A0's BARE caps are PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 x FIX.
phase_defaults:
  models:
    PLAN: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    IMPLEMENT: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    FIX: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    BARE: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    REVIEW: global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1
    AUDIT: global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1
  # REVIEW/AUDIT 60 turns / 30 min: the Sprint 258 smoke saw a review-catch AUDIT hit 40 turns after writing its
  # verdict (DEC-0490); BARE stays the implementer-side sum (PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 x FIX)
  max_turns: {PLAN: 30, IMPLEMENT: 60, REVIEW: 60, FIX: 40, AUDIT: 60, BARE: 170}
  timeout_min: {PLAN: 15, IMPLEMENT: 25, REVIEW: 30, FIX: 15, AUDIT: 30, BARE: 70}
  tools: "Bash,Read,Grep,Glob,Write,Edit,Task,WebFetch"   # identical for every arm, A0 included
phase_sets:   # D-4.1: A1's phases per task type; FIX runs only after a CHANGES_REQUIRED gate
  review-catch: [REVIEW, AUDIT]
  build: [PLAN, IMPLEMENT, REVIEW, FIX, AUDIT, FIX]

arms:
  - {id: a0_bare, label: A0, task_types: [all], toggles: {loa_mount: false}, phases: [BARE], effort: high,
     took_effect: [no_dot_claude, no_system_prompt, no_audit_rows, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a1_full, label: A1, task_types: [all], toggles: {}, took_effect: [all_phases_present, oracle_closed, integrity_clean]}   # oracle_closed: cycle-131 FR-1 (DEC-0615); review-catch runs only, a build run passes it vacuously
  - {id: a2_no_sprint_plan, label: A2, task_types: [build], toggles: {sprint_plan: false},
     phases: [IMPLEMENT, REVIEW, FIX, AUDIT, FIX],
     took_effect: [no_plan_phase, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a3_one_voice, label: A3, task_types: [all], toggles: {companion_voice: false}, took_effect: [one_voice_planned, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a4_no_gates, label: A4, task_types: [build], toggles: {gates: false},
     phases: [PLAN, IMPLEMENT],
     took_effect: [no_gate_phases, enforce_env_false, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}   # build only: on a review-catch task the gates are the task (DEC-0400)
  - {id: a5_no_flatline, label: A5, task_types: [build], toggles: {flatline: false},
     took_effect: [no_flatline_rows, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a6_one_window, label: A6, task_types: [build], toggles: {context_resets: false},
     took_effect: [implementer_single_session, gates_separate_sessions, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a7_effort_medium, label: A7, task_types: [all], toggles: {effort: medium},
     took_effect: [effort_flag_medium, skill_effort_stripped, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a8_no_ceremonies, label: A8, absent: true,
     evidence: "no /meeting command, skill or sosyete config key at 4d69c3c4 (grep -rli sosyete .claude/ docs/; ls .claude/commands .claude/skills)"}

rules:   # D-A5: pre-registered, mirrored in NOTES
  threshold_points: 0.03
  cost_lower_pct: 15
  bootstrap: {resamples: 10000, level: 0.90, paired: true, units: {hidden_test_pass_rate: tasks, defect_catch_rate: defects}, also_report: {defect_catch_rate: tasks}}   # DEC-0399
  primaries_by_arm: {build_only: [hidden_test_pass_rate], all_types: [hidden_test_pass_rate, defect_catch_rate]}   # DEC-0400
  cap_failure: counts_as_failed            # 0 on each applicable primary (DEC-0393)
  exclusion: {statuses: [degraded, contaminated, interrupted], mode: pairwise, inconclusive_above_share: 0.25}
  sensitivity_figure: cap_failures_excluded  # printed, never decides
  multiple_comparisons: none                 # expected false positives at 0.90 over 6 components printed
  drift_guard: {cli_version: fixed_per_batch, model_ids: fixed_per_batch}   # DEC-0407
  order: trial_major_seeded_shuffle_within_block
  took_effect_per_trial: true                # a miss → infrastructure_error, arm paused until --clear-arm (DEC-0418)
  predicates:                                # DEC-0416, DEC-0393, DEC-0530; d = arm − A1 point estimate, [lo, hi] its 90 % interval, c/w = cost/wall-clock Δ %; evaluated in this order
    inconclusive_by_degradation: "the arm's excluded share > 0.25 (whatever its interval; DEC-0393)"
    investigate: "else any applicable primary has lo > 0"
    keep: "else any applicable primary has d < -0.03 and hi < 0"
    inconclusive: "else any applicable primary has d < -0.03, or no valid pair"
    remove: "else every applicable primary has d >= -0.03 and (c <= -15 or w <= -15)"
    simplify: "else (every applicable primary within -0.03, cost similar)"
  review_catch: {defect_counts_once_across_gates: true, false_positive_dedupe: cited_region, verdict_accurate_iff: "CHANGES_REQUIRED when the key holds a high or critical defect, APPROVED when none"}   # DEC-0420
  inconclusive_extension_trials: 2
  h1: "a1_full beats a0_bare on at least one primary with the interval excluding zero, else halt before promotion"
  a4_sensitivity: "a4_no_gates worse than a1_full on hidden_test_pass_rate with the interval excluding zero, else harden tasks before acting on other arms"
  decision_states: [investigate, keep, inconclusive, remove, simplify, not_run_cut, inconclusive_by_power]
  mde_cut: 0.10   # sprint Task 3.4: an arm whose MDE at affordable trials exceeds this is pre-declared inconclusive_by_power and not run

load_adversarial_config() {
  local type="$1"

  # Defaults
  CONF_ENABLED="false"
  CONF_MODEL="gpt-5.3-codex"
  CONF_TIMEOUT=60
  CONF_BUDGET_CENTS=150
  # cycle-131 FR-4 (SDD D-4.2): the budget scaling — `fixed` (the shipped behaviour) or `diff`; _SET says the key was written
  # (the envelope names the scaling only then, so a config without the key writes the envelope it always wrote)
  CONF_BUDGET_SCALE="fixed"
  CONF_BUDGET_SCALE_SET="false"
  CONF_BUDGET_CENTS_MAX=600
  CONF_COMPANION_VOICE="true"   # cycle-126 FR-2.1: the second, other-family chain (opt-out per block)
  CONF_COMPANION_CHAIN_ANTHROPIC=""  # review sprint-248 C-011: optional operator chains (space-separated)
  CONF_COMPANION_CHAIN_OPENAI=""
  CONF_ESCALATION_ENABLED="true"
  CONF_SECONDARY_BUDGET=$DEFAULT_SECONDARY_TOKEN_BUDGET
  CONF_MAX_FILE_LINES=500
  CONF_MAX_FILE_BYTES=51200
  CONF_SECRET_SCANNING="true"
  CONF_SECRET_ALLOWLIST=()  # Patterns that should NOT be redacted
  # cycle-124 FR-7: the KF-004 repair loop has no flag any more — it always
  # runs on the UNENFORCED branch and never on a schema-enforced payload.
  # cycle-129 FR-7 (D-7.4): advisory voices — run after the counted voices, findings only under advisory_voices[]
  CONF_ADVISORY_VOICES=""       # space-separated aliases (default none)
  CONF_ADVISORY_TIMEOUT=600     # one wall clock for all of them
  CONF_PROMOTION_MIN_RECALL=""  # hounfour.advisory_promotion.* — read and named; promotion is unreachable this cycle
  CONF_PROMOTION_MAX_REFUTED=""
  # cycle-129 FR-8 (D-8.1): hounfour.locality — hosted (default, the rollback) | local_voices | invalid (refused in main)
  CONF_LOCALITY="hosted"
  CONF_LOCALITY_RAW=""

  if [[ ! -f "$CONFIG_FILE" ]]; then
    log "Config file not found, using defaults"
    return 0
  fi

  if ! command -v yq &>/dev/null; then
    log "WARNING: yq not available, using hardcoded defaults"
    return 0
  fi

  local config_key
  if [[ "$type" == "review" ]]; then
    config_key="code_review"
  else
    config_key="security_audit"
  fi

  CONF_ENABLED=$(yq eval ".flatline_protocol.${config_key}.enabled // false" "$CONFIG_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "false")
  CONF_MODEL=$(yq eval ".flatline_protocol.${config_key}.model // \"gpt-5.3-codex\"" "$CONFIG_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "gpt-5.3-codex")
  CONF_TIMEOUT=$(yq eval ".flatline_protocol.${config_key}.timeout_seconds // 60" "$CONFIG_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "60")

  CONF_TIMEOUT=$(_conf_uint "flatline_protocol.${config_key}.timeout_seconds" "$CONF_TIMEOUT" 60 1)

  _adv_conf_budget_scale "$config_key"
  # `false // true` is true in jq/yq semantics — read the raw value and default only when absent
  local _cv _cvl

head/evals/graders/recall-vs-defects.sh:135 — The head-dir fallback can read agent-writable content, so the grade can be tampered with. When EVAL_HEAD_DIR is unset and `<manifest dir>/../<fixture>/head` is missing, the same-scope clause and the citation-validity rule read `<workspace>/pr/head`. ablation-grade.sh calls the grader with workspace = grading/, and grading/pr is a copy of the sandbox pr/ (copy_tree runs before grade_recall). grade_recall also pops EVAL_HEAD_DIR whenever resolve_pr_fixture fails (ablation-grade.sh:1629-1636), so an agent that rewrites pr/head/<file> can redraw the definition spans and line counts that decide credit. The header at ablation-grade.sh:45-50 promises "never the agent-writable sandbox pr/". When the immutable fixture's head/ is unavailable this should fail closed (clause (ii) off, no validity rule), not fall back to the workspace copy.
head/evals/harness/ablation-grade.sh:1669 — Recall and false positives now use different rules. recall/defects_caught use "pm3_or_same_function", but false_positives() (line 1607) still counts every citation more than ±3 from an anchor as stray. A citation that only the same-function clause credits (credits_function_only) is therefore counted both as a caught defect and as a false positive. The report's precision (true defects / (caught + false positives)) and flagged-region counts double-count it. The same split shows up in recall-vs-defects.sh:434 refuted_share, which marks a scope-credited finding as "refuted". The FP and refuted regions need to include the same-scope credit.
head/evals/harness/ablation-grade.sh:1994 — The KF-046 class 7 exemption unit is too permissive. Every field in FIELDS is exempted, including WebFetch.url and WebSearch.query. A WebSearch for the bare `0xHoneyJar/loa`, or a WebFetch of an upstream URL that appears in a PR comment, is a substring of a fixture line, so it is exempt instead of a repo_name hit, and those are real probes of the upstream repository. Because the unit is the whole stripped *line* of the value, a multi-line Bash command can also put the token alone on one line (for example a heredoc line `0xHoneyJar/loa` feeding `gh api repos/$R`) and be exempt. Limit the exemption to non-network fields and to Bash with heredoc bodies stripped, or require the unit to be more than the token itself.
head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:1153 — The rule split cuts build rows off from review rows of the same suite version and pin. When review-catch rows carry two grader rules (old 1.2.x rows read "pm3" next to 1.3.0 rows, which is exactly the mixed-grade case this adds), every build row goes into a separate "· rule n/a" partition. The primary partition then has hidden_test_pass_rate pairs but no catch rows, or catch rows but no pass-rate pairs. H1, A4 and every all_types component decision lose one primary and read "no pair". Build rows have no catch rule and should stay with every rule partition of their pin, or the split should apply to the catch metric only.
head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:1138 — Partitions never key on the mount or config condition this PR introduces. Rows from before cycle-131 (open mount, fixed budget) and rows after it (closed overlay, config_variant=eval with budget_scale diff) share suite_version 2 and the suite pin source_commit. Once the old rows are re-graded under 1.3.0 they also share grader_rule, so they are pooled into one cell even though the treatment differs. overlay_mode and config_variant are already on the row and should be part of the partition key, or the change should bump suite_version.
head/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml:81 — oracle_closed is a post-run took_effect rule only for a1_full (line 77). a3_one_voice (here) and a7_effort_medium (line 89) also run review-catch tasks on the closed mount and are contrasted against a1_full, but their runs never get the post-run clauses (b)-(d): mount_mutated, a later-only copy, foreign objects in the sandbox .git. Only a1_full can be rowed infrastructure_error for an oracle exposure, so exposure is checked unevenly between the arms being compared. Add oracle_closed to every mounted arm whose task_types include review-catch.
head/evals/harness/ablation-row.sh:466 — dissent_absent_reason checks "disabled" before it looks at the envelope, and it derives "disabled" from flatline_protocol.enabled == false. adversarial-review.sh gates only on flatline_protocol.<gate>.enabled, so for the flatline: false arm a gate whose dissent ran (or failed for budget or error) is rowed "disabled", a planned absence, and the dissent-absent sensitivity never excludes it. The inputs are also the post-run sandbox/.loa.config.yaml, which the agent can write. A Bash edit setting code_review.enabled: false turns a budget or error absence into "disabled". Use the pre-run arm evidence and the envelope instead.
head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:709 — The _pm3_v1 defect vector is built over the current key's defect count n, with missed_pm3_v1 mapped to current positions (ablation-grade.sh positions(..., pos, pos_v1)). recall_pm3_v1 itself is detected / len(v1 defects). When the v1 manifest lacks a defect the current key has, that defect is absent from missed_pm3_v1 and the vector reads it as caught (1.0). The per-defect beside interval then disagrees with the row's defect_catch_rate_pm3_v1. Also note that missed_consistent gets caught=None here, so the check that would catch this is skipped.
Verdict: CHANGES_REQUIRED

content.text:
My verdict is **CHANGES_REQUIRED**, with eight findings written to `/workspace/review.md`. I couldn't run the test suites because this checkout is incomplete. The findings come from reading the code, plus spot-runs of the grader's scope logic and the oracle diff-section parser on sample inputs.

**Grading integrity:**
- **Agent-editable grading input** (`recall-vs-defects.sh:135`, with `ablation-grade.sh:1629`): if the protected copy of the PR fixture can't be found, the grader quietly reads the agent's own `pr/head` instead. The agent can rewrite those files, which decide whether a citation counts. It should refuse to use the scope rule rather than fall back.
- **A catch can also count as a false positive** (`ablation-grade.sh:1669`): recall now credits a citation anywhere in the same function as the defect, but the false-positive count and `refuted_share` still use the old ±3-line rule. A finding credited only by the new rule is counted twice, which skews the precision figures.
- **Repo-name exemption is too broad** (`ablation-grade.sh:1994`): the "quoting the PR" exemption also covers web searches and web fetches. A search for `0xHoneyJar/loa`, or a fetch of an upstream URL that appears in a PR comment, is exempted even though it probes the upstream repo. A multi-line shell command can also put the name alone on one line and get through.

**Report statistics:**
- **Build rows split off** (`ablation-report.py:1153`): when review rows carry two grading rules (the mixed old/new case this PR is for), all build rows land in a separate partition. The main hypothesis (H1), the A4 check and the component decisions then lose one of their two primary metrics.
- **Open- and closed-mount runs pooled** (`ablation-report.py:1138`): partitions ignore the new mount and config settings. Old open-mount rows and new closed-mount rows share the suite version and commit pin, so once the old rows are re-graded they mix into the same cells.
- **v1 beside-figure** (`ablation-report.py:709`): this one is minor. The per-defect "v1" vector is sized to the current defect list, so a defect the v1 list lacks reads as caught.

**Run verification:**
- **Uneven post-run check** (`ablation-2.0.yaml:81`): only `a1_full` runs the post-run closed-mount check (`oracle_closed`). `a3_one_voice` and `a7_effort_medium` also run review tasks and are compared against `a1_full`, but nothing checks their runs for tampering or exposure.
- **Dissent wrongly marked "disabled"** (`ablation-row.sh:466`): the row writer marks a gate's dissent as planned-off whenever `flatline_protocol.enabled` is false. That setting doesn't actually stop `adversarial-review.sh`, and it is checked before the envelope is looked at. It also reads the post-run sandbox config, which the agent can edit, so an agent could relabel a budget or error failure as planned.

I checked and dismissed one possible grader bug (functions misread as one line when the header comment ends with `}`); it only fires in rare cases. Nothing under `pr/` was modified.
